ADR Control
===================================================

**device names: adr_control, adr_control_1, adr_control_2, ...**

There are different ADR control objects available. The main control object can be accessed using
"adr_control" as device name. Individual ADR units can be accessed by appending a numeric id like "adr_control_id".
These units might offer limited functionality.

   :show-inheritance:
   :inherited-members:
